item.text:
## Ranked proposals

1. **A small “Changing Shoreline” table display using pattern FW-7.** The later workshop record describes paper cutouts casting bands of light and explains the changing-shoreline idea; the pattern record describes a portable three-band silhouette ([workshop notes](</tmp/work/01-projects/folded-water/workshop.txt>), [pattern description](</tmp/work/01-projects/folded-water/shape-diagram.txt>)). Mara and her collaborator permit FW-7 in a free community educational display, with both makers credited ([FW-7 terms](</tmp/work/03-rights/folded-water.txt>)). The shelf inventory lists card, blue scraps, scissors, and tape, though it was checked on October 2 and should be checked again ([craft-box note](</tmp/work/02-assets/notes/craft-box.txt>)). A previous prototype used similar materials ([materials note](</tmp/work/01-projects/folded-water/materials.txt>)).

   **Next step:** Confirm the materials are still available, make one paper prototype, and ask library staff to confirm a date for the table. Credit both makers on the display. The motorized lightbox from the old plan was never ordered and is unavailable ([old plan](</tmp/work/01-projects/folded-water/old-plan.txt>); [resource note](</tmp/work/04-resources/other-materials.txt>)). One archive note describes a two-slit version while the later workshop and pattern records describe three; no final-authoritative signoff is supplied, so confirm the intended pattern with the makers before producing multiples ([old copy](</tmp/work/02-assets/notes/old-copy.txt>)).

2. **A text-led “Tide Lines” educational display, without photographs or audio.** The concept concerns how changing water levels reshape familiar paths ([concept](</tmp/work/01-projects/tide-lines/concept.txt>)). Mara permits reuse of her captions and observation notes in free public educational displays ([Tide Lines rights](</tmp/work/03-rights/tide-notes.txt>)). Those materials include two short captions and three dated water-level observations ([text fragments](</tmp/work/01-projects/tide-lines/text-fragments.txt>); [observations](</tmp/work/01-projects/tide-lines/observations.txt>)). Up to twelve black-and-white pages are quoted at $8, within the $30 cap, though studio printing depends on printer availability ([printing quote](</tmp/work/04-resources/printing-quote.txt>); [studio printing note](</tmp/work/02-assets/notes/printing.txt>)).

   **Next step:** Draft a one-page display using only Mara’s permitted text, label the observations as informal field notes, and verify the historical claim about the path moving inland in 1981 against its original reference before including it ([research note](</tmp/work/01-projects/tide-lines/research.txt>)). Confirm printer availability and the library date before committing to production ([venue](</tmp/work/04-resources/venue.txt>); [calendar](</tmp/work/04-resources/calendar.txt>)).

## Unresolved possibility

**Tide Lines with photographs** remains a hypothesis, not a current proposal: the indexed images depict identifiable people, and their photographer’s agreement bars public display or exhibition without separate written consent. No later consent appears in the record ([photo terms](</tmp/work/03-rights/photo-terms.txt>); [photo description](</tmp/work/02-assets/notes/photo-description.txt>)). The files are also absent from this archive ([photo index](</tmp/work/01-projects/tide-lines/photos-index.txt>)). Do not use them unless the required consent is obtained and the actual files are available. Sound S-3 is similarly unavailable here, with ownership and public-use permission unconfirmed ([sound terms](</tmp/work/03-rights/sound-terms.txt>); [sound index](</tmp/work/02-assets/notes/sound-index.txt>)).

## Scope and uncertainties

I reviewed the files returned by a recursive workspace inventory, including project notes, resource records, rights records, and archive notes; this does not establish that the textual archive contains every relevant record or asset. The venue is only tentatively available, and its date is not booked. Both proposals fit the stated free educational-display purpose and appear feasible within the stated weekend and budget, subject to the checks above ([request](</tmp/work/04-resources/request.txt>); [venue](</tmp/work/04-resources/venue.txt>)).
